intro: Gameweek 7, gentlemen, and Brighton put five past Crystal Palace without breaking a sweat. Man City beat Ipswich 3-2 and Arsenal nicked it 1-0 at Forest. Leeds and Man Utd shared the points at 1-1. Ben scored 70 and Asher managed 31, a gap you could park a bus in. Ben now leads on 378, 42 clear of Asher in second. Jonny is third on 325 and nobody moved an inch in the table. Absolute scenes, if you're Ben. Everyone else is just watching.
motw: Ben, 70 points. Brighton's back line and Kostoulas did the heavy lifting, with Vuskovic, Konsa and Tavernier all in double figures or close. The title race is not ON. It's over, and he's on the podium with a trophy. Set and forget, gentlemen.
stinker: Asher, 31 points. Martinez scored 8 on the bench while the XI limped along with a lot of 6s and 3s. Gyökeres got 24 minutes and 1 point, which feels about right for the week. Still second, but the cushion is getting thin.
bench: Jamie left 23 points on the bench. Neto got 15 for two goals and a clean sheet, and he watched it all from the dugout. The bench is where points go to die, and this one got a proper funeral. Somebody tell him the bench isn't a trophy cabinet.
bench_jam: Louie, take a bow. Sávio went down and Bassey came on for an 8-point auto-sub, with a clean sheet and 10 defensive contributions. That's a hospital ball nobody could see coming. Never in doubt, apparently.
red_card: Josh owns the red card this week, and it goes to Schade. 45 minutes for Brentford, a yellow card, two goals conceded and zero points. Brentford lost 2-1 to Liverpool and Schade took the hook at the break. Squeaky bum time for the Victory Delap faithful.
gloves: Asher again, with Donnarumma, who got 1 point. Two conceded against Ipswich and one save in 90 minutes. Haaland scored twice for Louie at the other end. Good for Louie, awkward at the next dinner.

xi.1: Raya, 9 points, clean sheet and 3 bonus. In his pocket for Louie.
xi.504: Vuskovic, 11 points with an assist, a clean sheet and 12 defensive contributions. Brighton's wall did the business for Ben.
xi.114: Boscagli, 10 points for Jonny. An assist and a clean sheet in 80 minutes, and the Brighton rinsing continues.
xi.31: Konsa, 9 points for Ben. A clean sheet and full bonus at Forest, and another Ben player in the XI.
xi.156: Neto, 15 points for two goals and a clean sheet, and the best score of the week. He sat on Jamie's bench. Brutal.
xi.53: Manzambi, 11 points for Jamie. A goal and a clean sheet in 71 minutes in Villa's 1-0 win. At least one of Jamie's picks showed up.
xi.261: Iwobi, 11 points for Louie. A goal and a clean sheet as Fulham beat Hull 1-0.
xi.68: Tavernier, 10 points for Ben. A goal, a clean sheet and 10 defensive contributions in 78 minutes.
xi.411: Haaland, 13 points for Louie with two goals and full bonus. Man City still conceded twice, because of course they did.
xi.138: Kostoulas, 12 points for Ben. A goal and an assist in 70 minutes as Brighton hit five.
xi.79: Evanilson, 12 points for Brahmes. A goal and an assist as Bournemouth beat Sunderland 2-0. The only real highlight on his team sheet.
